svg.title: HealthOS system architecture v2
svg.desc: Six-layer architecture: external clients route through a FastAPI gateway to a LangGraph orchestrator, which dispatches to three specialized agents backed by PostgreSQL, Redis, Weaviate, and HAPI FHIR, all using a tiered LLM routing layer.

g.text: FastAPI · OAuth2 / JWT · RBAC · rate limiting · OpenAPI docs
Task routing · HITL interrupt gates · Postgres checkpoints · multi-tenant isolation
